candidates.explanation: In the `else if (userByEmail)` branch, any existing account whose status is not inactive (including active, confirmed password accounts) is silently relinked: provider is overwritten to the social provider and socialId set, then saved. This hijacks the active email/password account, so email login then reports 'needLoginViaProvider'. The condition is inverted/insufficient: it should not overwrite an active account with a different provider (e.g. only link/adopt when the account is inactive/unconfirmed, or reject with a conflict error).

fix.description: In the `else if (userByEmail)` branch, do not overwrite provider/socialId on an active account that uses a different provider (e.g. email). Either throw an UnprocessableEntityException (e.g. email: 'emailAlreadyExistsWithProvider'/'needLoginViaProvider') when userByEmail.provider !== authProvider and the account is active, or only adopt the account when it is inactive/unconfirmed. Only update when the existing account is not an active password account.
